title: Hard Times Don't Have to Define You
html:
Hard times come for everyone. Financial pressures, health scares and setbacks that feel overwhelming.

But those who get through them have one thing in common: they refuse to let circumstances dictate their future.

The truth is, you get more of what you focus on.

Focus on scarcity, and you'll see only lack. Focus on opportunity, and your awareness expands. You start noticing ways to earn, save, recover and grow.

Asking yourself better questions. For some, asking themselvesmore challenging questions helps here.

Instead of dwelling on financial struggle, ask:How can I create more income or reduce my spending?

Instead of fixating on health problems, ask:What can I do today to move toward healing?

Life is short. Every day spent waiting is a day lost.

Circumstances may not change overnight, but your state of mind can change right now. Click! Changed. And that change will lead you to better circumstances.

This week's Motivator:

I will not be defeated by hard times. I will control my outgoings, seek new income, and develop a mindset that attracts opportunity. I will become opportunity-conscious.

Prompt for the week:

What's one opportunity you could act on this week that would move you closer to stability or growth, instead of waiting for things to change on their own?
